portfolio.intro: I build complete web applications, from interface design to the APIs and business rules that make the product work.

about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I'm a fullstack developer who enjoys turning loosely defined problems into clear, usable applications. My work combines thoughtful interfaces, understandable business rules, and reliable integrations.
about.paragraph2: On the front end, I mainly work with React, Next.js, Vue, and TypeScript. On the back end, I build APIs and services with Node.js and PHP, connecting applications to relational databases and external services.
about.paragraph3: I also write about what I learn. Documenting decisions helps me organize ideas, share context, and build software more intentionally.

items.title: Clear, responsive products
items.description: Building accessible, component-driven interfaces that remain consistent across devices.

items.title: APIs and business rules
items.description: Developing services, integrations, and data flows that support complete web experiences.

items.title: Code prepared to evolve
items.description: Modular organization, explicit contracts, and technical decisions that reduce coupling and unnecessary maintenance.

items.title: Reliability before deployment
items.description: Behavior validation, performance awareness, and attention to the details that affect product users.
